scope: Research/verification only. No Civic Map asset additions, removals or coordinate edits in this step.
methodology: Retain Makati City publications as the authority for the historical/public-park inventory.
Use newer Makati plans, MMDA/PIA government reporting and current map geometry to establish present existence and current identity.
Do not collapse a historical park name into a newer nearby park unless location/name continuity is sufficiently supported.
Treat a missing distinct current map object as a hold, not evidence that the park no longer exists.

sources.role: Official named public-park inventory and locations.
Current city heritage-planning evidence retaining Plaza Cristo Rey and Poblacion Park as heritage landmarks/sites.
Government reporting that Makati and MMDA inaugurated EDSA-Pinagkaisahan Park in 2023.

parks.ownershipManagement: Listed by Makati as a public park in 2020 and on the official urban-greening park map.
parks.officialAddress: J.P. Rizal Avenue, Barangay Poblacion, Makati City

currentMapEvidence.nearbyVerifiedAsset: Makati City Hall complex remains active at J.P. Rizal/Poblacion.
currentMapEvidence.note: Current map/business search resolves Makati City Hall and Building II but not a separately named Makati City Hall Park.

parks.requiredAction: Find a newer DES/DEPW/City Hall grounds source or map feature that confirms whether Makati City Hall Park remains a distinct park asset.

parks.officialAddress: A. Bonifacio Street, Barangay Valenzuela, Makati City

currentMapEvidence.note: Current map geometry identifies Valenzuela Linear Park at A. Bonifacio Street, matching the official Makati park location.

notes: The 2010 DES inventory used the name Valenzuela Linear Park; the 2020 Makati list shortened it to Valenzuela Park. Current map identity supports the older linear-park name.

parks.officialAddress: A. Bonifacio Street / Pasig River edge, Barangay Poblacion, Makati City

currentMapEvidence.note: Current map geometry identifies Poblacion Linear Park, address in Poblacion, Makati. The regional label sometimes resolves to Mandaluyong because the asset sits on the Pasig River edge; the feature address/operator identify Makati.

notes: Public historical/current references describe it as the riverfront extension of Makati Poblacion Park.

parks.ownershipManagement: City-recognized public heritage plaza; exact operating department is not established by the reviewed current source.
parks.officialAddress: D.M. Rivera / P. Gomez area, Barangay Poblacion, Makati City

currentMapEvidence.note: Current park geometry identifies Plaza Cristo Rey beside Sts. Peter and Paul Parish Church in Poblacion.

notes: Makati's current Cultural Development Plan continues to identify Plaza Cristo Rey as a heritage landmark within the Poblacion heritage core.

parks.ownershipManagement: City of Makati / MMDA for the currently verified EDSA-Pinagkaisahan park improvement.
parks.officialAddress: Kalayaan Avenue, Barangay Pinagkaisahan, Makati City

laterGovernmentEvidence.note: Makati DES designed and Makati/MMDA inaugurated EDSA-Pinagkaisahan Park in February 2023.

currentMapEvidence.note: Current public park references identify EDSA-Pinagkaisahan Park in Pinagkaisahan, but the reviewed evidence does not prove it is the same site as the 2020 Kalayaan Avenue Park.

parks.requiredAction: Establish whether Kalayaan Avenue Park and EDSA-Pinagkaisahan Park are the same park or distinct assets before implementation.

parks.ownershipManagement: Listed as a public park by Makati in 2020.
parks.officialAddress: J.P. Rizal Avenue, Barangay Poblacion, Makati City

currentMapEvidence.nearbyVerifiedAsset: Makati Poblacion Park currently contains a children's playground.
currentMapEvidence.note: No distinct current 'Playground Park' object was found; treating it as the playground inside Makati Poblacion Park would create a duplicate unless documentary evidence proves that relationship.

parks.requiredAction: Trace barangay/DES/DEPW records or current site plans to determine whether this remains a separate park or is part of Makati Poblacion Park.

parks.officialAddress: H. Santos Street / Pasig River edge, Barangay Carmona, Makati City

currentMapEvidence.note: Current map geometry identifies Carmona Linear Park on H. Santos Street, the same location used by Makati's 2020 'Riverside Carmona' entry.

notes: The current name/address/operator and the historical 'Riverside Carmona' location support treating Carmona Linear Park as the present identity of the Makati inventory entry.

findings: Valenzuela Linear Park, Poblacion Linear Park, Plaza Cristo Rey and Carmona Linear Park have sufficient present-day evidence for implementation.
Makati City Hall Park remains an official public-park record but needs a distinct current park confirmation.
Kalayaan Avenue Park should not yet be renamed or merged with EDSA-Pinagkaisahan Park.
Playground Park at Brgy. Poblacion should not be duplicated against Makati Poblacion Park until its current identity is resolved.
